lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (approx. 10-15px in diameter) arranged in a grid-like lattice posterior to the branchial region, extending across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming a matrix of grid-like nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light pixels above to shadowed pixels below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the lower and middle regions of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras), including one high-luminance individual positioned horizontally along the ventral margin of the pectoral fin.
